messages:
derek-s: Hi folks — I was on unpaid sabbatical during open enrollment and just returned. I got married while I was away (ceremony 2026-12-05). Open enroll closed 12/01. Can I add my spouse now or do I need to wait until next OE?

natalie-peopleops: Congrats Derek! Marriage is a qualifying life event (QLE). Normally you have 30 days from the event to make enrollment changes. Since your marriage was 12/05 youre within the window. Upload a marriage certificate and choose an effective date (event date or end of month) and well process.

derek-s: I registered late because HR onboarding for my return was delayed — will that affect eligibility? I was technically not on payroll while on sabbatical.

natalie-peopleops: Being off payroll doesn't block a QLE. What matters is timely documentation. If you submit the marriage cert within 30 days we can add your spouse midyear. If we get docs after 30 days you can submit an exception request but its discretionary.

derek-s: Okay uploading now. If we add midmonth, how will payroll handle premiums? Any retro?

ben-payroll: If effective date is 12/05 we prorate premiums for December and apply the deduction on the next paycheck after processing. If you prefer 12/31 (end-of-month) full month premium applies. For retro adjustments we can smooth over two pay cycles on request. Tell us which you prefer.

benefits-bot: :gear: Ticket B-55501 created "Marriage QLE - derek-s". Please attach marriage certificate and spouse ID.

mona-hr: Quick note: If you were off payroll and had COBRA from prior coverage, please confirm whether spouse had continuous coverage. That affects coordination and COBRA notices but not our ability to enroll them as a dependent.

derek-s: Uploaded marriage cert and spouse ID to ticket B-55501. Prefer effective 12/05 and split any retro over next 2 cycles. Thanks.

natalie-peopleops: Received — moving ticket to In review. Setting effective 2026-12-05 and notifying payroll to prorate and split retro across next two runs per request. Mona: will you confirm COBRA note if needed?

ben-payroll: Noted. We'll prorate and split adjustments across next two paychecks.

mona-hr: Will check COBRA vendor history and confirm via ticket. Congrats again! :tada:
